title: Add in-conversation message search to Chat
goal: Let users find a message in the currently selected conversation by searching its text, without changing stored history.
context: Long conversations become difficult to navigate. Inline search makes prior answers and user prompts discoverable.
forbidden_changes: Do not modify conversation persistence, ordering, or message contents.
Do not search conversations other than the currently selected one.
Do not change send, streaming, cancellation, or prompt execution behavior.
Do not claim physical-device acceptance without testing a real iPhone.
acceptance_criteria: Chat menu exposes Search this conversation and disables it when history is empty.
Search filters current conversation messages by case-insensitive substring.
UI displays matching count, clear-search, and no-match state.
Closing search clears query and restores all messages.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
verification: Confirm required workflows pass on final PR head.
Verify search, clear, no-match, and close behavior on a physical iPhone.
recovery: Keep search compact if vertical space becomes constrained; preserve matching count and no-match feedback.
